tests.name: signed in on a phone viewport: Settings → Privacy reads GET /api/v1/me/phone from the staging gateway (enabled:false while PHONE_VERIFY_ENABLED is off), shows no phone number card and no verify button, keeps the discoverability switch, no overflow; read-only — nothing is sent or written

tests.reason: Sending a code, confirming it and removing a number send an SMS and write to the shared production database, so they are proven here: the dialog steps and what each sends, numeric one-time-code autofill, the resend timer, a message for every gateway error code (unknown codes fall back), the card and the Find friends hint hidden while the switch is off or the status call fails, Verify / Change / Remove with a confirmation, numbers LTR inside RTL, and every new string in eleven locales (German du-form).
